userStories.title: FAQ Administration API & Lifecycle Governance
userStories.description: Implement administrative FAQ management API with search, category filtering, homepage visibility toggle, reordering, RAG embedding synchronization, and audit logging
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/v1/admin/faqs returns all FAQs with search, group filter, showOnHome filter, isActive filter, pagination, and sorting
GET /api/v1/admin/faqs/:id returns FAQ detail with group, order, showOnHome, homeOrder, isActive, question, answer, and slug
POST /api/v1/admin/faqs creates new FAQ with automatic slug generation, RAG embedding sync, audit logging, and cache invalidation
PUT /api/v1/admin/faqs/:id updates FAQ content, order, group, showOnHome, homeOrder, isActive, with slug conflict check, RAG sync, audit logging, and cache invalidation
DELETE /api/v1/admin/faqs/:id soft-deletes FAQ (isActive: false) with audit logging, RAG sync, and cache invalidation
PATCH /api/v1/admin/faqs/:id/toggle-home toggles showOnHome boolean flag with audit log and cache invalidation
PATCH /api/v1/admin/faqs/:id/toggle-active toggles isActive boolean flag with audit log and cache invalidation
PATCH /api/v1/admin/faqs/reorder accepts array of { id, order, homeOrder } and updates sequence in transaction with audit log and cache invalidation
Strict RBAC: creation, editing, reordering, deletion restricted to admin and editor roles; read accessible to admin, editor, sales, viewer

userStories.title: FAQ Manager Desk UI with Live Markdown Preview & Reordering
userStories.description: Build comprehensive FAQ Manager page using DataTable, FilterBar, and AdminDrawer with Markdown answer preview and homepage featured toggle
acceptanceCriteria: FAQ Manager renders with DataTable, FilterBar, and AdminStatusBadge components
Top metric strip displays Total FAQs, Featured on Homepage, Active Groups, and Inactive FAQs
FilterBar supports search, category group dropdown, homepage filter (All, Homepage Only, Full FAQ Only), and status filter
Table displays Question text, Category Group badge, Homepage Featured toggle pill, Active status badge, Display Order, and Quick Actions

Slide-over AdminDrawer features question input, category group selector with commercial presets, order inputs, homepage toggle, active toggle, Markdown answer editor with live rendered preview, and deep-link preview

userStories.title: Automated FAQ Test Coverage & Zero Public Regression
userStories.description: Verify FAQ administration features with integration tests and confirm zero public site regression
acceptanceCriteria: Admin API client in client/src/admin/api.js provides fetchAdminFaqs, fetchAdminFaqById, createAdminFaq, updateAdminFaq, deleteAdminFaq, toggleAdminFaqHome, toggleAdminFaqActive, and reorderAdminFaqs

Automated integration tests in server/tests/faq-admin.test.js cover list filtering, creation with auto slug, update with RAG sync, toggle homepage, toggle active, reorder, soft delete, and RBAC rejection
All client and server test suites pass with 100% success
Zero visual regression on public site verified via verify:no-change
